Onias, the high priest of the Jews, was known. Year 1730. Seleucus, king of Syria,
captured Demetrius, king of Asia, in Sicily, where he had come for divination. He killed him and took his kingdom.
Year 1732. Ptolemy died, and Ptolemy Philadelphus reigned over Egypt in his place for thirty-eight years.
Year 1736. Seleucus died, and Antiochus Soter reigned over Syria in his place for nineteen years.
Year 1737. The Scriptures were translated on the island of Pharos in seventy days.
Ptolemy Philadelphus. For he was a man who loved beautiful things; and Philadelphus is interpreted as “lover of beautiful things.”
When he heard about the books of the Jews, he [sent] to all their leaders and asked them to translate them for him from the Jewish language into Greek.
For this reason he set free the Jewish captives in Egypt. And with the royal vessels in Jerusalem,
he sent to Eleazar the high priest and Sosthenes. He made every effort to have the books of the Jews translated from the Hebrew language into Greek,
and into the library established for him there in Alexandria (he placed them). The year one thousand
and seven hundred forty-five. Silver coins were minted in Rome. From this point an evil growth spread over the world.
From this point the spring poured out bitter water and made the world drunk on the foul dregs of the love of money. The year 1746.
The philosophers Polemon and Epicurus died. Arcesilaus [?], Crates, Zeno, and Erasistratus the physician became well known.
The year 1755. Nicomedes, king of Bithynia, built a city and named it Nicomedia after himself.
In that same year the king of Syria died, and Antiochus reigned for fifteen years. After Eleazar the high priest,
his uncle Manasseh received the high priesthood. The year 1768. The Parthians rebelled against the Macedonians,
and Arsaces, their first king, ruled over them. For this reason they are called Arsacids. The year 1770.
Philadelphus died, and Ptolemy Euergetes became king over Egypt. In that very same year the king of Syria also died,
and Seleucus Callinicus reigned for twenty years. At this time Jesus son of Asira
and Simon son of Onias, the priests, became well known. The year 1790. The Romans killed as many as forty thousand Galatians.
The year 1793. There were severe earthquakes in Caria and Rhodes, so that the Colossus fell.
At this time Shamuni and her sons won glory through martyrdom for the fear of God. The year 1396.
Ptolemy Philopator reigned over Egypt for seventeen years. The year 1808. There was a battle between Antiochus,
king of Syria, and Ptolemy, and Ptolemy was defeated. The year 1814. There reigned over Egypt
Ptolemy Epiphanes, for twenty-four years. The year 1824. Antiochus fought a battle against the Romans,
and Antiochus was defeated. He also made a treaty with them, agreeing to pay them a thousand talents a year, after his defeat at Thermopylae.
The year 1826. Ptolemy and Antiochus made peace with one another, and he established a treaty of friendship with him
and gave him his daughter Cleopatra in marriage. Antiochus assigned him Phoenicia and Syria, together with Samaria and Judea, as a dowry.
The year 1829. The fifth millennium was completed according to the reckoning of the Seventy, in the 148th Olympiad,
in its first year, and in the year 1829 of Abraham. The year 1837. The king of Egypt [?] died.
After him, Ptolemy Philometor reigned for thirty-five years. Aristobulus, the [?] philosopher, became known.
In the year 1800 and [?], Antiochus abolished the laws of the Jews and first compelled the people to adopt pagan practices.
He subjected those who would not obey to bitter tortures. Afterward he went up to Jerusalem and plundered the temple of God and the vessels in it.
He set up an image of Zeus in it. In Samaria, on Mount Gerizim, he also built a temple of Zeus, since the Samaritans had asked him for this very thing. At that time,
Mattathias, one of the priests, the son of Shamuni, from the village of Modein, rose up with his sons against the commanders of Antiochus, in defense of
the law of his ancestors, in the 153rd Olympiad. The events recorded in the book of Maccabees took place at this time.
In the year 1854, Judas Maccabeus, the commander of Judea, the son of Mattathias, drove the commanders of Antiochus out of his country.
He purified the temple and restored the worship of his ancestors, which had been suspended for three years. In the year 1859, Judas Maccabeus died.
His brother Jonathan took his place for nineteen years. In the year 1860, Aristarchus became known.
In the year 1871, Appius conquered the Celts, and Carthage was destroyed by Scipio.
It had been 668 years since its founding, or, as others say, 748 years.
In the year 1872, Ptolemy Euergetes became king over Egypt for twenty-nine years.
In the year 1876, Tryphon killed Jonathan the high priest. Simon took his place for eight years.
Tryphon also killed Antiochus, the son of Alexander, king of Syria. In the end, he too perished.
In the year 1880 of Abraham, the first king reigned over Edessa: Aryu, son of Hewya, for five years.
Edessa was named after him. They began in the 161st Olympiad and came to an end in the 249th Olympiad.
In the year 1882, Antiochus, king of Syria, came against Jerusalem and drew up his forces for battle against it, after his treaty with Simon.
He was defeated, and his army was destroyed. In the year 1884, Simon the high priest was killed, and John took over,
his son, after him. Ptolemy lost his rule over Egypt, and his mother became queen. In that year, Abdu, son of Mazur, became king over Edessa for seven years.
In that very same year, Arsaces the Parthian killed Antiochus. At this time, the slaves in Sicily stirred up rebellion and war.
When they were captured and imprisoned, they were afflicted in prison by [?], until they resorted to eating one another.
In the year 1894, the king of Edessa died, and Fradashat, son of Gebaru, became king for five years.
In the year 1897, Hyrcanus, the Jewish high priest, destroyed Samaria, the city of the Samaritans,
and razed it to the ground. It is the city that is called Sebaste among us. Afterward Herod rebuilt it and named it Sebaste. In the year 1900,
Bakru, son of Fradashat, became king over Edessa for three years. After him, Bakru, son of Bakru, reigned for twenty years. In the year 1901.
Ptolemy Physcon reigned over Egypt for seventeen years and six months. In the year 1910, there was a great earthquake in Rhodes.
And it caused great destruction there. In the year 1912, John the high priest died, and his son Aristobulus succeeded him for one year.
After him Alexander arose and ruled for twenty-four years. In the year 1918, there was another revolt of slaves in Sicily.
In the year 1919, Ptolemy, who is Alexander, reigned over Egypt for ten years. In the year 1924, Seleucus, son of Antiochus,
king of Syria, was burned alive. In the year 1928, Physcon reigned over Egypt for eight years.
And Ma‘nu ruled over Edessa for four months. After him Abgar Piqa ruled for twenty-five years and nine months.
Here the kingdom of Syria and Asia also came to an end. They began in the 117th Olympiad and came to an end in the 171st Olympiad.
The total of their years was 219 years and ten months. At this time Sulla devastated Athens.
In the year 1937, Ptolemy Dionysius reigned over Egypt for thirty years.
Abgar killed Bakru and reigned alone for twenty-three years and five months.
In the year 1940, Selina, Alexander’s wife, reigned over the Jews. From this point the affairs of the Jews fell into confusion.
In the year 1944, the Romans devastated Antioch in Syria. In the year 1960, the king of Edessa died.
The people of Edessa were without a ruler for one year because of a dispute arising from the desire for power. Afterward Ma‘nu, who was called a god, reigned over them
for eighteen years and five months. In the year 1966,
Cleopatra reigned over Egypt for twenty-two years. At that time Gaius Julius Caesar devastated the Germans.
In the year 1967, Gaius Julius Caesar was the first king to reign over the Romans, for six years. In the year 1972,
Gaius was killed. Augustus, the second ruler, reigned in his place for fifty-six years and six months.
In the year 1980, the king of Edessa died, and Pacorus reigned for five years.
In that same year, this Pacorus and Barzapharnes, the army commander, advanced against Syria. He took Hyrcanus and Phasael, Herod’s brother, into captivity.
Here the kingdom of the Jews came to an end. Herod the Philistine was the first to reign over them, for thirty-seven years.
In the year 1985, Pacorus died, and Abgar reigned for three years. After him Abgar the Red reigned for three years.
After him Abgar the Red reigned for three years. After him Abgar the Red reigned for three years. Herod fought against Jerusalem and captured it,
tearing down both its walls and killing all [the people] within it. [?] In the days of Herod, when the birth of Christ drew near,
the hereditary high priesthood and the kingdom of the Jews came to an end,
as the prophecy given to Moses was fulfilled, which says: “A ruler shall not depart from Judah, nor a leader from among his descendants, until he comes for whom it is reserved.”
And he is the hope of the nations. Likewise, the anointed leader of the nations, who is spoken of in the prophecy to Daniel, came to an end.
For until Herod, the rulers were anointed men: these were the high priests who stood at the head of the Jewish people.
They began with the restoration of the temple in the days of Darius, in the sixty-fifth Olympiad, and came to an end in the days of Hyrcanus,
in the one hundred and eighty-sixth Olympiad. The intervening years amount to four hundred and eighty-three,
as the book of Daniel prophesies when it says, “Know and understand: from the issuing
of the word to give an answer and to build Jerusalem until an anointed leader, there will be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks.”
These sixty-nine weeks, then, complete a period of four hundred and eighty-three years,
corresponding to the years of rule of the anointed leaders. And after Hyrcanus, the last of them, was taken captive by the Parthians,
Herod son of Antipater, although he had no right to the kingship, received the kingship of the Jews from Augustus and the Roman Senate.
Afterward, his sons ruled until the final destruction of Jerusalem. But no longer did those of priestly descent
serve God as priests, nor did they serve for their entire lives according to the law of Moses. Instead, obscure men at different times,
some for one year each and others for even less, bought the priesthood from the Romans.
Daniel also prophesies these things when he says, “After seven and sixty-two weeks, the anointing will be destroyed, and there will be no judgment in it.
The people, together with the coming leader, will destroy the temple and the sanctuary. They will be cut off in the flood of war, and afterward,” he says, “amid the defilement of desolation.
Until the end of the times, complete destruction will be inflicted upon the destroyer.” Year one thousand nine hundred and eighty-eight.
Cleopatra plotted against the kingdoms of the Jews and the Arabs and strove to obtain their territories from Antony.
Year one thousand nine hundred and eighty-nine. Cleopatra came to make peace with Augustus in the mountains of Lebanon,
and there she and those who brought her were handed over to be killed, just as the prophet had foretold when he said, “The daughter of the king of the south
will go to the king of the north to make peace between them. She and those who brought her,” he says, “will be handed over.”
When Cleopatra, queen of Egypt, was condemned, her children Helios and Selene were also put to death.
In that same year Egypt was conquered by the Romans, and the kingdom of the house of Ptolemy, which had ruled for two hundred and ninety-five years, was dissolved.
In that same year the city of Nicopolis was built. Year one thousand nine hundred and ninety. Ma‘nu, who was called Saphelul, became king over Edessa
for eighteen years and seven months. Year one thousand nine hundred and ninety-one. There was a great and violent earthquake in Rhodes, and it destroyed many places.
The [?] also fell in the earthquake. Year one thousand nine hundred and ninety-two. The Romans conquered Calabria and Galatia
and subjected them to tribute. Year one thousand nine hundred and ninety-four. The Romans also conquered Cyzicus.
In the year 1996, there was a great and severe famine in Judea and Syria.
The people of the region scattered and departed. In the year 1998, Herod built extensively in Jerusalem.
He rebuilt Samaria from its foundations, since it had long been in ruins. To honor Augustus Sebastos, king of the Romans, he named it Sebaste [?].
In the year 1999, there was a great earthquake in Cyprus, and it destroyed many places.

Herod demolished the temple in Jerusalem and built another larger than it. In the year 2002, Tiberius
conquered the Vindelici and subjected all those who lived alongside Thrace. In the year 2005,
King Herod built the city of Caesarea and named it after Caesar, as well as Agrippina and Antipatris,

the year 309, the fruit of blessings, Jesus Christ, the Son of God, was born in Bethlehem of Judea.

The years from Abraham to the birth of Christ total 2016 years.
On the revelation to the Magi, their coming to Jerusalem, [and the offerings] they brought to Christ.
The account of the revelation and visions related by the kings, [sons of kings,] of the great East, who were called Magi in the language of that country.

[For in stillness,] without a sound, they offered praise and prayed. In silence and in their minds, they offered praise and prayed to the exalted and holy majesty of the Lord of life, to the holy and glorious Father,
who is hidden in his own great radiance and is exalted and holy beyond all our thoughts.
The human tongue cannot speak of him as he is, but only as he wills, when he wills, and through whom he wills.
Neither his upper worlds nor the lower ones can speak of his majesty, except as it befits the will of his majesty to be revealed to the worlds,
according to what they can receive from the gift of his majesty. For it is great, and they cannot fully describe it.
These, then, were the wise men who were called Magi in the language of the land, because in silence, without a sound,
they praised the God of all, through whose word and will everything that exists came into being, and everything that comes into being and [?], and everything that is yet to come into being.

Nothing happens apart from his will, and there is no one who can oppose the will of the Father of all.

The Names of the Wise Men and Kings.
These were their names: Zahrundad son of Artabanus; Hormizd son of Santrum; Ushtazaph son of Gudaphar; Arsaces son of Mihrum;
Zarnud son of Wadud; Arihu son of Khosrow; Artaxerxes son of Hawilat; Ashtanbozan son of Shishron; Mihrum son of Humam;
Ahasuerus son of Sahban; Nasardih son of Beladan; Merodach son of Bel. These are the kings, sons of eastern kings, in the land of Shir,
which is at the outer edge of the entire eastern region of the world inhabited by human beings, by Ocean, the great sea outside the world, east of the land of Nod,
where Adam lived, the great ancestor and head of all the families of the world. These sons of kings had received commandments and laws,
and also writings, from their fathers. Generation after generation had received them from one another, beginning with Seth, the son of our father Adam.
For Adam had revealed these things to his son Seth when he was born. Adam told Seth about his former greatness, before he transgressed the commandment,
and about his departure from Paradise. He warned his son Seth not to transgress against righteousness as Adam himself had done.
Seth received his father's commandment with a pure heart and observed it fully, also through the gift of the Eternal One, the Lord of majesty. And Seth was granted
the ability to set things down in writing, to make wisdom known, and to call upon the name of the Lord, the master of every soul that seeks life. Through him writing first appeared in the world,
inscribed in the name of the Eternal One. Seth handed down the writing he had inscribed to his descendants, and it was passed down to Noah, who was also found righteous
and was himself saved from the waters. [At the time of the flood, Noah also took] the books of commandments with him [into the ark.
And when] he came out of the ark, Noah too commanded the generation after him to recount his mighty deeds and the hidden mysteries written in the books of Seth,
concerning the majesty of the Father and all the mysteries. Those books and mysteries were passed down, together with that
discourse, through tradition, all the way to our fathers. He learned and received them joyfully and handed them down to us.
We too lovingly and reverently guarded the mysteries of those books, mysteries, and words. We prayed in silence, giving thanks and praise,
bending our knees and raising our hands toward the height of heaven, to the Lord of that majesty which is hidden from the eyes of every living being.
Those books of hidden mysteries were kept on the Mountain of Victories, east of our land of Shir, in the cave, the Cave of Treasures of the Mysteries of Life [?].
Our fathers also instructed us, just as they themselves had received instruction from their fathers. They told us, “Wait for the light that will shine upon you
from the exalted East of the Father's [?], the light that shines from on high in the likeness of a star over the Mountain of Victories
and rests upon the pillar of light inside the Cave of Treasures and Hidden Mysteries. You too must instruct your children, and your children their children,
until the mystery of the star that shines from the exalted majesty appears to your descendants: a light like a star, illuminating all creation.”
And he dims the light of the sun, the moon, and the stars; not one of them can be seen or can stand before his light.
For he is the [?] mystery of the Son of the supreme Majesty, who is the Father's voice, the offspring of his [?] thought.
The light of the radiance of his glory, the will and image of his hidden being, the Word that gives birth to every thought.

The spring of life that never runs dry from its source, the Word that created everything according to the will of the one who sent it, the image that has no form or likeness among all things that exist.
He is the one by whose power and word all the worlds were ordered and established. He is the Son of perfect love; he is the radiance of the light
of the glory of the Father of ineffable Majesty. Now know that when this light dawns upon you from that Majesty which has no limit,
and appears to you in the likeness of a star, so that you can see it, eagerly, with joy and love and complete diligence, taking pure offerings from what belongs to him,
which your fathers placed in the Cave of Treasures of the Hidden Mysteries on the Mountain of Victories, go wherever the light of the star shines for you.
And you will see a great and wondrous rest: God appearing in the bodily form of a human being, while disfigured, poor, insignificant, changed, and humble.
And the sign of the cross will also be visible upon him. Go before him with love and joy, carrying your offerings with you.
And bow down before the child who is sovereign, humble, and slain. Present your offerings to him, and receive from him the blessing of life.
And you will share with him in joy when he comes in his hidden glory, in his perfect divinity, and in his complete wealth that never passes away,
and in his new world, in his light of [?], and in the perfect life that he will give to everyone. You too, take care and instruct your children.
And if the coming of the light of the star does not happen in your days, your children must also tell their children,
until the mysteries and revelations written about his coming are fulfilled. And we received laws and commandments from our fathers, and we too used to teach all the mysteries.
And we used to warn the children: “Perhaps the coming of the light of this star will take place in your days, just as we received and learned from our fathers.”
And we used to go up to the Mountain of Victories. When we had all gathered, each from his own dwelling, at the foot of the mountain, we would remain together in one place, in purity,
on the twenty-fifth day of every month. And we would immerse ourselves in a certain spring that was at the foot of the mountain.
That spring was called the Spring of Purification. Seven trees stood beside it: an olive tree, a vine, a myrtle, a pine, a citron, a cedar,
and a cypress. That whole mountain was beautiful and lovely beyond measure, more than all the mountains in our land. The fragrance of every kind of aromatic plant wafted from it.
And the dew that sprinkled it had a sweet fragrance. Whenever the beginning of the month came, we would go up and make our way to the mountain's summit.
And we would stand before the entrance to the Cave of Treasures of the Hidden Mysteries. We would kneel on our knees and stretch out our hands to heaven.
And we would pray and worship in silence, without a sound, before the Father of the supreme Majesty, which cannot be spoken of or bounded, forever.
For three days each month. And we would enter the cave, going to the treasures stored there, which had been prepared as offerings for the star,
and for the worship of that light for which we were waiting. And when we returned from reading and hearing [the revelation], we would descend with joy.
We used to speak and teach our children and our families, and everyone who lovingly devoted himself to learning.
And if one of us should happen to die, we would appoint his son or one of his relatives in his place, just as we had taken the place of our fathers,
until the time for the star’s coming was fulfilled. The people of that land, too, who devoted themselves to the love of the revelation so that they might learn with joy—
we used to teach them. And those who did not want to learn and kept themselves far from help,
because they saw our stillness as we prayed in silence, we would respectfully tell them
our mysteries. Again, from the books that were in the Cave of Treasures of the Hidden Mysteries: every saying that our father Adam spoke,
the great head of our family, with his son Seth, who was born to him after the death of Abel, whom his brother Cain killed.
His father Adam mourned for him. Adam informed his son Seth about [?] and about the revelation of the light of the star
and its glory, because he used to see it in the Garden of Eden as it descended and rested over the Tree of Life
and illuminated everything, before Adam transgressed the commandment of the Father of the Majesty on High. And when he transgressed the commandment laid down for him,
the sight of the star was taken away from him, also because of his departure from Paradise. Our father Adam mourned over the wrongdoing through which he had been brought down from his greatness.
He earnestly warned his son Seth and taught him to walk in righteousness so that he might find mercy before the Father of Majesty.
He would say to him, “My son, generations and ages will come from me and from my offspring. They will recount my wrongdoing
and tell proverbs to one another in the towns, applying them to me. They will say, ‘Every kingdom divided against itself will not stand.’
This applies to me, for I was divided against the kingdom in which I stood, and with my own hands I lost it. My son,
the rib that was separated from me became a file and blinded my eyes. I myself had prophesied when I saw her and said, ‘This time, bone and flesh from me.’
And rightly I called her ‘a time,’ because she became a stumbling block to me. My son, guard yourself against her in the words of your mouth, and do not reveal to her all the secrets of your heart.
For my compassionate great Lord made her a helper for me, for honor and glory, because he loved me like a beloved son. But I made her into
a source of harm to me, one who uprooted my steps, until she brought me out of the Paradise of my kingdom. I did not reflect on my honor.
Instead, I became proud in my heart through the deceitful advice she gave me: a cup of hearing bitter words, through the serpent’s deceit.
I did not reflect on my former condition, when I did not exist, or on the honor I possessed when I came into being, or on my authority over the whole world,
or on my love for the holy Watchers, or on all my life within Paradise, and, above everything else, on the mercy and kindness of my holy great Lord,
who loved me and cherished me like a kind father. When I presumptuously transgressed his commandment, he did not judge me like a master who bears a grudge, but like a kind father
whose mercy is mingled with his discipline. For if he had judged me according to my wrongdoing, he would have swept me away like a breath
and made me as though I had never existed. Who could stand against him and say to him, ‘What have you done?’ But he disciplined me mercifully.
And he did not judge me according to my foolishness. For you have seen, my son, that all creation remains under my authority, as it was before.
And the evil deceiver, through his deceit, wanted to bring me low and escape from my authority. Vigilantly, in his mercy, my kind Maker [?]
put him beneath my feet for me to trample on him, while instilling fear in me so that I would no longer listen to his advice.
And as a judge acting in his righteousness, he shut his lying mouth and filled it with dust. He broke his legs so that he could not walk on them,
setting him apart from all the animals created like him. All these things happened to me, my son, and I was brought down from my greatness.
Your mother Eve became a stumbling block to me, the cause of every evil. But you, my son, beware of her advice, and do not listen to her as she did.
Instead, love and honor the Lord of life, my kind Maker [?], and he will give you life and have mercy on you. For from my family
and my children there will be glorious and honored people who speak of the mysteries of the Majesty. They will find abundant mercy. They will pray and make petitions, and they will be heard.
And [?] of the Majesty. In the latter days of that generation, they will again become rebellious. They will not take warning from my foolishness or from the judgment that came upon me.
Instead, they will act boldly and speak blasphemy even against the Majesty on high, and they will say many things.
They will also make painted and carved images. They will worship even the sun and the moon, and they will speak blasphemous words.
All these things that happen among them will come from the schemes of the deceitful trickster. For with the affection of his deceit and his cunning, which is full of bitterness,
he will approach each of the generations that will come after me. He will ensnare and entice them with the empty glory of great wealth,
of high standing, clothing, possessions, sexual immorality, boasting, injustice, oppression, and possessions of every kind.
He will appear to them as a loved one and a friend, and he will entice them, also through singing and drunkenness and through filthy, defiled festivals,
which are the desire of his empty visions [?]. Through all kinds of licentious things, too, he will ensnare them with his deceitful and unseemly love.
In the same way, through Eve, he approached me with his deceitful speech, as though he were modest and concerned for me.
He said, “Look, I am advising you to do something right and fitting for you. When you eat from what you were commanded not to eat,
you will become like your God, my kind Maker [?].” And I, wretched as I am, did not understand, despite my honored position, that his deceitful advice could not come true for me.
Clay cannot become like the one who fashioned it, nor a servant like his master. But I know the abundant mercy of the Majesty of my Maker [?],
the kind one, which will be revealed to me at the end of days. At the last he will rescue me from corruption and raise me from the dust,
just as he brought me into being when I did not exist. My enemy rejoiced and exulted over me because I had fallen through his cunning.
My kind Savior and my gracious Maker [?] are ready to support me and show me compassion in his mercy. When I descend into darkness, he strengthens me with his light
and gives light to my eyes, as he did for me before, when he breathed breath into my nostrils and I breathed [?].
But you, my son, please the one who fashioned me and gave me life—you and your generations after you—so that you may find mercy before him.
For he does not punish you for my sins, because of his kindness. For if he had punished me according to my wrongdoing, I would not have produced fruit.
Nor would he have accepted an offering from your brother Abel, nor would he have demanded an accounting for his blood from the hands of his brother who killed him.
For in his abundant mercy he does not neglect anyone who loves him and walks before him in righteousness.
Even those who sin before him he gives room to repent, and he has mercy on them if they repent and appeal to him.
For his mercy toward his world is abundant. And Seth heard everything that his father Adam commanded him—commandments more numerous than these.
And he wrote them down diligently. We found them in books that had been deposited in the Cave of Treasures of Hidden Mysteries.
He himself also gave instructions and added to them. Seth purified his heart so that he would not obey the evil deceiver. He praised and called upon the name of God [?] of the supreme majesty [?].
Seth also entrusted these mysteries to his sons. And we used to read them every month when we went up the mountain.
We would lovingly enter the Cave of Treasures of Hidden Mysteries [?]. We too would learn and teach our children and our descendants.
But when the time came for the fulfillment of what was written in the books concerning the revelation of the light of the hidden star, we too were deemed worthy that in our days
it should come, and that we should receive it joyfully, as our ancestors had instructed us and as we ourselves used to read in the books.
And each one of us used to see astonishing and extraordinary visions, such as we had never seen before.
But their mysteries were contained in these books that we used to read. And each one came from his chamber,
according to our former custom, so that we might go up Mount Victories [?] to bathe in the Spring of Purification, as we were accustomed to do.
And we saw [?] in the form of a pillar of indescribable light, descending and resting above them [?]. We were afraid and trembled when we saw it.
And above it was a star of light whose brightness we cannot adequately describe, for its light was many times greater than the sun’s.
The sun could not withstand the light of its rays. And just as the moon appears during the daytime in the days of Nisan,
when the sun shines and it is swallowed up in its light, so the sun appeared to us when the star shone upon us.
It was to us ourselves and to those who shared our mysteries that the light of the star appeared, brighter than the sun, when the star shone upon us.
It was to us ourselves and to those who shared our mysteries that the light of the star appeared, brighter than the sun. It appeared to no one else,
because they were far removed from its mysteries and its coming. And we rejoiced and offered praise and thanks without measure
to the Father of supreme majesty, because it appeared in our days and he made us worthy to see it. And when we had joyfully immersed ourselves in the Spring of Purification,
we went up the Mountain of Victories, as we were accustomed to do. We went up and found that pillar of light in front of the cave.
Great fear again came over us. We knelt on our knees and stretched out our hands according to our former custom.
In silence we offered praise at the sight of its wonders. And again we saw heaven opened like a great door.
And the men of glory, carrying the star of light in their hands, came down and stood upon the pillar of light.

The whole mountain was filled with its light, which no human mouth can describe. And something like the hand of a small human being came toward us from the pillar and dimmed our eyes, so that we could not look at it.
[And he strengthened us.] And we saw the star enter the Cave of the Treasures of Hidden Mysteries, and that cave shone beyond measure.
And we heard a gentle, pleasant voice calling and saying to us, “Come inside in love, without hesitation, and see a great and wonderful vision.”
And we took courage and were strengthened by the words of the voice. We entered in fear and bent our knees at the entrance of the cave because of the abundance of the light.
And when we stood up at his word, we raised our eyes and saw that light which no human mouth can describe. And as it gathered itself together,
it appeared to us in the bodily form of a small and humble human being and said to us, “Peace to you, children of my hidden mysteries.” And again we were astonished at the vision.
And he said to us, “Do not doubt the vision you have seen: that indescribable light appeared to you, the voice of the hidden Father of exalted majesty.
And he appeared to you again, gathering his light into its rays, and appeared to you in the likeness of a small, humble, and lowly human being.
For the inhabitants of the world cannot bear to see the glory of the only Son of the Father of majesty unless he appears to them in the likeness of their world.
And other signs are also destined to appear in him, concealing and disfiguring the exalted majesty for the salvation of human lives.
For my Father loved them, so that they would not perish in the error in which they were walking. And I, too, will fulfill the Father’s love.
For their lives I will descend even to death on the cross, so that I may raise them up in myself, in love and in undivided wholeness,
if they believe in me without doubt and through me give thanks and praise to the Father of that glorious majesty, who sent me
for their salvation. And I loved them so that they would not perish in the error in which they were walking. And now that I have appeared to them at the culmination of all ages,
they have no excuse for their sins unless they repent and believe in me. And you too, what you were commanded by your fathers,
and everything you learned from the mysteries of the books you used to read—do everything
that was told to you. For behold, the hidden mysteries of the light of the star, which you were waiting to see—
behold, he himself has revealed to you what concerns himself, as far as you are able to hear and believe without doubt.
For you see me in places of many forms. And take with you the treasure deposited in this cave for your fathers, and remain in joy.
And worship [?] born as a human being. And worship me there also. Even now, while I am speaking with you, I am [there] also.
For [my good news] was proclaimed through angels. I am there also, and I am also with the majesty of my Father. And I am everywhere, because I am the ray of light
whose light has dawned in this world from the majesty of my Father, who sent me to fulfill everything spoken about me throughout the whole world
and in every place, [in mysteries] that cannot be expressed, so that I may fulfill the command of my glorious Father, who proclaimed me through the prophets to the rebellious house.
In the same way, what concerns me was revealed to you also, as was fitting for your faith. And I am going up with you.”
And I will be your guide along the whole road you travel, as you see glorious signs,
and great victories throughout the earth, and the fulfillment of all the mysteries in Jerusalem.
You will see again, and everything spoken to you will be confirmed for you. You will also see signs of humility, and an appearance that is lowly and weak,
so that people will even attack me and want to carry out their deceitful plans, but they will not be able to have their way.
Instead, everything they do will lead to their own death and destruction. And the Father's will shall be fulfilled for the salvation of the life of the whole world.
And when he had spoken all these things to us, along with many others that we have no time to recount because of their exceedingly great number,
we all went out from the cave, rejoicing and glad that we had been considered worthy to have all these mysteries of that indescribable majesty revealed to us and spoken to us.
And we took all the treasure that had been deposited in the cave, with the letters in which it had been placed still sealed.

And we came down from the mountain, praising the mysteries revealed by the light of the star that had appeared. Each of us told the others about the revelations and visions that had appeared to him in the Cave of the Treasures of Hidden Mysteries.
His appearances were not alike, nor were all the wonders that appeared to us in many forms. One of us said:
“I saw a light containing many marvelous images.” And another said, “I saw an infant who had indescribable forms.”
And another said, “I saw a young man who has no likeness in this world.” And another said, “I saw a man who was humble, lowly in appearance, and meek.”
And another said, “I saw a cross and a man of light hanging on it, bearing the sins of the whole world.” And another said:
“I saw him descend to Sheol in power, and all the dead rose and worshiped him.” And another said, “I saw him rise
in glory, open the graves, and raise the dead, who cried out, ‘Holy is our King, and holy is his descent to us!
For our sins he humbled himself to save us.’” And another said, “I saw him ascending to the highest height,
with angels opening the gates of heaven before him, and clouds of [?] and [angels] carrying him on the palms of their hands.
And the Spirit, the Paraclete, was carrying a diadem and a crown, [?] all the heavenly hosts in honor of his humility, which had won the entire struggle against error and death.”
And as we came down from the Mountain of Victories, we praised and recounted to one another all these things, others like them, and still more, concerning everything we had seen and heard there.
And we were filled with great joy and great gladness because we had been considered worthy to see this entire gift of life,
which all the kings, righteous people, prophets, and mighty men had prayed, hoped, and waited to see—this vision that they did not see,
because it was not yet the time for the coming of the star of light, the giver of perfect life to those who believe in him.
And while we were offering these praises, suddenly a voice again came to our ears from the supreme height of majesty, amid great light and with indescribable sweetness,
saying to us, “Everything you have seen and heard and spoken, and everything that has been said to you, at which you now marvel, is a single drop of life from the dwelling of majesty.
For no one can know all the mysteries of oneness except the one who comes forth from the thought of the Father's hiddenness.”
And no one knows the Father except the voice that brings forth the Word of life, which reveals the hidden depth of the Father's thought, in whom he exists
forever. Through him, through the voice and the Word, the upper and lower worlds of the Father of greatness came into being and were put in order:
the angels, powers, rulers, and authorities, and also this world [?] in which you stand, and height, depth, length, and breadth.
There is nothing else that exists outside the will of the Father of greatness, or that came into being without the voice of life.

For this is my beloved Son, the messenger of perfect mercy. This is the one who reveals the Father's hidden things to his beloved, as is fitting for them and as they find strength to receive from the Son's gift.
This is the one who announced the new and perfect worlds to those who are persuaded and believe in him. This is the interpreter of wisdom [?] and of the hidden mysteries.
This is the form and image of the Father of greatness, whom he always obeys. This is the only Son, who fulfills his Father's entire will.
This is the one who is not loved and honored as he deserves, because that world loved darkness and its desires more than him.
This is the one who humbled himself and became human for the salvation of human beings. So that they would not perish, he willingly put on a body, a disfigured form,
so that through it he might kill death. He took away death's authority so that he might give eternal life
to those who love him and believe in him. This is the one in whose name wonders [?] and signs take place through the hands of his faithful.
This is the perfect Son, who does the will of the one who sent him. This is the way and the gate of light for those who enter through him. This is the one who is in everything,
and is named and spoken of above everything. This is the bread of life that comes down from me to believers. He is the sower of the Word of life.
He is the true shepherd, who gives his life as a ransom for his flock. He is the high priest who makes atonement for the worlds with his blood.
He is the drink of the vine of life. This is the one whom you saw, who appeared to you in many forms, and from
my love he is not stripped, nor from the very being of his glory. No one comprehends him or his greatness, so as to say what he is like,
except me. And I and he are one, existing in glory that cannot be expressed.” And when all these things, and many more than these,
were spoken to us about him, concerning the revelation that appeared to us—the star in all its excellent forms, as we were able to see him—
we spoke about him like weak human beings, unable to express anything of what we had seen.

We made preparations with the whole company [?], with provisions and pure and holy offerings, which we brought from the Cave of Treasures of the hidden mysteries, [which had been stored] there long ago for our fathers.
We set out with great joy, our hearts rejoicing as we went to the place appointed for us, to worship him, the vision of the star of light. Here it ends.
And he appeared to us again, our guide and good messenger, our perfect light and glorious leader—the star—as he went before us,
supporting our entire company on every side and illuminating us with his hidden light. We had no need of the light of the sun or of the moon,
because their light was dim in his eyes. By night and by day we traveled in his light, rejoicing and glad,
without distress or weariness. He prepared a blessed lodging ahead of us for us to stay in, where we rested and rejoiced.
Our provisions also seemed plentiful to us, and they did not run out. Instead, they increased more and more each day.
He rested upon us with his light and relieved us of all our weariness, as though we were not traveling on a road.
He leveled the mountains, hills, and difficult places before us. Even the rivers before us we crossed on foot,
without fear, because of the light of our good guide, who accompanied our company.
And whenever we passed through places inhabited by wild animals and dangerous snakes, we trampled them under our feet.
At every stopping place, our leader and guide appeared in his glory to each one of us, in all kinds of forms and visions.
He filled our hearts with great joy, and all the stages through which we traveled seemed short and easy to us.
For our victorious sign and our mighty light, who is too great for any human mouth to describe, was himself leading us by his victorious power.
When we reached the region of Jerusalem, in the month of flowers, our good messenger led us into Jerusalem.
Its nobles and leaders were disturbed and shaken, and they asked us, “For what reason have you come here? Is it because of the mysteries of your practice as Magi?”
For they saw us looking toward heaven, worshiping our sign, and praying to our leader.
Because they did not know our mysteries, they regarded us as magicians. We told them, “We saw the sign of the Majesty on high in our land,
just as we had been instructed by our fathers: a king, the Messiah, the giver of life and savior, who gives himself over to death for the sake of the whole world,
has been born here. We have come because we saw all his signs and the forms of his hidden divinity, in the likeness of a human being clothed in a body.
We have come rejoicing, with our pure offerings, which had been set aside for our fathers in the Cave of Treasures of Hidden Mysteries, on the Mountain of Victories.
He commanded us in a great vision to come to this place to worship him with reverence.
For he has worshipers in every place, and he becomes their giver of life and savior and forgiver of sins. Through him the Lord of all is reconciled to his creation
and pardons his people.” And he sent and summoned the [honored] elders of the city—
Herod, the ruler of the region—and asked them where it was written that the king, the Messiah, the savior and giver of life to the worlds, would be born.
They all told him with one voice, “In the village of Bethlehem, as was spoken by the Majesty on high to our father David, the early prophet who lived in former times.”
When we heard what they said, we again rejoiced greatly. When we heard what they said, we again rejoiced greatly.
While we were rejoicing, we saw our guide and leader, and our joy increased still further. As we spoke of all the mysteries and revelations and uttered praises,
we went joyfully to Bethlehem, as the blind scribes had read. They did not believe what they read from their scriptures.
Nor did Herod, the ruler, who was blind and sightless to the love of the light born in their land, the light that has existed since before the ages.
Yet they had lived in darkness in the world all their days. But he, [Herod], told us deceitfully, “When you have seen the Messiah,
Again he said to me, “So that I too may go and worship him.” But he was not worthy to worship the light that had been born,
because he was a dwelling place of error. We were told by our guide and our light not to go to him.
For he was not worthy to see the [?] light of the world, because he was entirely deaf and blind to worshiping him.
We went and entered Bethlehem with [?], which [?] would be called the village of the holy child and of the great light that dawned in it, to kill and destroy all error and abolish death.
Then we all entered the courtyard where he had been born. We saw a cave resembling [?] and having the appearance of the cave of treasures of hidden mysteries in our country,
from which we had learned the hidden mysteries that proclaimed him, which had been placed there by our ancient ancestors.
They were fulfilled [?] today through our coming here. We saw the pillar of light descending, just as we had seen it before.
It stood in front of the cave. The star of light descended and stood above the pillar, with angels on its right and its left.
When we saw it again, we rejoiced while also being afraid. The pillar, the star, and the angels went ahead of us into the cave where the mystery and the light of life had been born.
A loving voice urged us, “Come inside.” We entered behind him, took our crowns, and placed them beneath his feet.
For the everlasting kingdom is his. We knelt and worshiped before him on the ground, because every knee in heaven and on earth bends before him and worships him.
We opened our hidden treasures. We had carried them while they were sealed and had come to the treasure of life, sealed in exalted majesty.
We turned our treasures toward him, the treasure of life, so that we might receive them from him many times over in the kingdom,
before his judgment seat of life. The glorious child opened his mouth, and the primordial light fulfilled the will of the Father of majesty.
He said to us in the love of his abundant and gracious mercy, “Peace to you, children of my hidden mysteries, children of the dawning of the light from on high.
For you have been found worthy to see the primordial, eternal light—you and your ancestors. And just as you have been found worthy, see, you have received him with perfect love, without doubt.

You will also be found worthy to see him in his great light, before which there are no more mysteries, because they are all fulfilled in him. He alone reigns over everything from now on, and everything is subject to him. I am
indeed the one who revealed myself to you in your country and spoke with you through mysteries. I also became your guide and leader here, until you came to me in peace.
I will also be with you until the end. I will not depart from you, nor from any of those who believe in me with perfect love.
You too will be my witnesses in the land of the East, together with my disciples, whom I have chosen for myself to proclaim my good news.
When I have fulfilled my Father’s will in everything he commanded me, I will ascend in the glory in which I was with him. Even now, as I speak with you, I am also with him,
and I have not been deprived of the Father’s majesty. I will now give you another sign at which you will marvel:
when [?] you see the sun grow dark during the day as though it were night, and a great earthquake occurs on the earth,
and the voices of the dead are heard praising from their graves, then know that all the times and hours have been fulfilled through my coming to you. Lift your eyes to heaven,
and see it opened in glory before me, as I ascend with the praise that is due to me.”
And I sit at the right hand of the Father of majesty, from whom I was sent to give life to the world.” And while the Giver of life was speaking all these things with us,
that whole cave shone brightly and appeared to our eyes like another world—that cave appeared to our eyes like another world, whose light had no equal.
And many voices of hope were speaking, and [?], beyond counting: “Yes and Amen! Firstborn, who opens hidden wombs!

Holy child, who fulfills the will of the majesty on high, who is the Yes that brings fulfillment! Everything came into being through him. And Amen! Through your light and your word were perfected and brought to completion
all the worlds, visible and invisible. All the angels and heavenly powers worship you. Yours is the land of life, to give to your chosen ones.
And yours is the primordial light, for you are the beloved fruit of the Father’s thought [?]. You are the image and the will of the Almighty,
the revealer of hidden things. For it is through a spoken word that everything in the mind becomes known. You are everything, and everything exists in you.
Nothing exists outside your will.” When all these praises had been spoken and we had heard them, we were afraid and trembled, and fell to the ground like dead people.
The boy, the child of light, stretched out his right hand powerfully and laid it on us. He strengthened us and said to us, “You who share in my mysteries, do not be afraid.
For all these things that you have seen and heard from the first day until today, and at which you marvel—as do those who hear them—
are not greater than I am. But they are overwhelming to you because you are clothed in weak flesh. To me they are very small.
For because of your weakness, you cannot see or hear even one of the great things that I have with the Father who sent me.
But just as you have been found worthy to see and hear these things at this time—and now you marvel at how great they are in your eyes—
so, through my eternal love for you, you will again be found worthy to see and hear those great things that cannot now be spoken.
Not even the Watchers and angels can fully speak of them, because they are far too great even for them. Now rise and go in peace to your land, you who have received the light.
For you have been found worthy to receive the perfecting light of the majesty on high. And you shall come and worship him with your offerings,
with joy. And now you have fulfilled everything commanded to you by your fathers.
You have also been found worthy to know and learn the ancient hidden mysteries written down for you from the earliest generations.
Now you have seen the fulfillment of your mysteries, and you have fulfilled everything commanded to you, out of love for me and as a testimony to me.
You have also been found worthy to be my witnesses in the East, together with my disciples, who were chosen for me before the world came into being.
When I have fulfilled my Father’s will in everything he commanded me, and have ascended to him in glory, I will send to you in your land some of my chosen ones who have been chosen for me.
They will speak and testify to the truth together with you, so that your seal may be in one accord. Rise, then, and go in peace,
while I remain with you in every vision and sign, just as I have been with you from the first day.
For just as I am here in an appearance and in every form—and you marvel at all the visions and forms in which you see me—so I am also with the Father of majesty, whose will I am from eternity.
I will never be separated from you, nor from the Father. For I am a ray of his light, and I was sent to you to enlighten you.”
And look, you are amazed like weak human beings. How much more if I came to you in the majesty of my Father! For you would not be able to stand before me.
Not even the angels and powers who are above you—when I descended upon them and they saw the vision of wonders, they stood in fear and trembling.
I appeared to them as was fitting for them, and I appeared to you in a way that you could bear to see.
For the Father of majesty has no form or likeness in this world, except that I shine forth from him, being his will, his power, and his wisdom, and I am
in my Father, and my Father is in me. And I am as it is fitting for God to appear and for the world to know him.
And likewise, according to the ability of the children of wisdom to receive and hear with love the majesty of the Father who sent me. And now I have appeared to you in human likeness,
to fulfill everything written about me, because of the cause and folly of the sin of Adam, your first father, which brought you down to Sheol.
Death gained power over you, and Error ruled over your generations through deceit. In her arrogance she thought that she had become your master and that you had become her possession forever.
But I will make your freedom known to you again, and also your ancestors and your original lineage, for you are descended from light.
You were not created in the world for nothing. Heaven and earth and all the worlds came into being for your sake.
And because of this love, the Father of majesty sent me, and I put on your likeness, so that in it I might put an end to and destroy all your oppressors and captors.
I will present you before the Father as a pure and perfect offering, with none of the stains of Error in you.
I will set you free in love and truth, through pure water and birth from the Holy Spirit.
And in love you will be my brothers and faithful ones, like newborn children with none of the stains of evil in them, from now and forever.
From now on, he will establish joy, praise, and thanksgiving from you in the highest heights through me, who am his will.
And joy, salvation, fellowship in the Spirit, and eternal life will be given to you through my hands, with everything in completeness, without division.
As from the beginning, we will be beneath the Father's wings, while his power sanctifies you and has mercy on you, and his [?], his pure [?], forever and ever.
And again a voice was heard from on high, from every direction, and from within the earth, as they answered
and said, “Amen! The will of life, [?], and joy and peace to all the worlds!”
And when we had received the commandments of life from him, we went out from his presence with great joy, abundant gladness, and praise.
Our hearts were filled with great hope of returning to our own land. Joseph and Mary, honored and blessed people, went out with us.
They had been found worthy and entrusted to be called, and to be in name, parents and caregivers of the child of the voice heard by the virgin,
and caregivers of the perfect will of mercies that bring fulfillment. Mary became a gate for the great light that entered the world in grace to drive away darkness.
And she became a dwelling place of life [for God, the offspring of her soul [?]], who appeared in human limbs. And she will have a name, remembrance, and blessedness for generation after generation.
And they raised their eyes and saw the light that had been born through mercy in their house, that he was with us and accompanied us. And they said to us:
Your stay with us [?] did not please us. You took away the light and the great hope of the whole world. You went away with him and deprived us of him.
Through great grace, we were considered worthy to be appointed as his servants, to nurture the body that appeared in our house. And now, look, we have seen him going with you.
We say to her: Blessed woman, blessed among women, blessed Mary, who through mercy were considered worthy to receive conception by the Spirit through your pure hearing,
and to give birth to the child of life, the eternal Word—you who were trusted and considered worthy to be called his mother.
And now, look, your glorious child is inside ahead of you. Look, he is waiting for you in the house, although he does not leave our side either,
just as he himself told us. For he is the great gift of life, which through your child was given to all the worlds. And the mystery that had been hidden from
ancient times in the Father of all was revealed to us through your child. And the treasure of life that had been kept for all generations appeared.
This great gift and the light of life do not belong to you alone, but to all the worlds, those above and those below.
Lift up your eyes and see: he is throughout creation and gives light to all of it, and it is filled with his glorious mysteries.
And now he has appeared in the world in a body. His images, too, appear with him everywhere, because he was sent from his majesty for the life and salvation of everyone.
And Joseph and Mary returned, rejoicing over all these things they had heard about the holy child, and went to their house.
Mary entered and found the child of light laughing and offering praise for all his great and wonderful mysteries, which were proclaimed about him throughout the whole world
from the earliest time. And now they were all being fulfilled in his appearance today. He was praising and giving thanks to his Father, who had sent him for the salvation of his worlds.
Mary and Joseph bowed down before him, and she said to him: I rejoiced to see the treasure of life,
and my light, the holy child conceived through the hearing of my ears, who opened my womb through his holy mercy, the Lord of my holy virginity.
I rejoiced greatly to find in my house the great treasure to which I had given birth, and my great, eternal light [?]. For I had thought, my beloved,

that the men from the East had taken you, because of your great love for them, in return for the offerings they presented to you from what belongs to you. For I saw [?] your holy image going with them.
He answered in a sweet and gentle voice and said to Mary: Peace to you, my mother and the one who nurtures me, who were considered worthy to be blessed among women.

Because you were considered worthy of the fruit of the living voice [?], which you received and conceived with love in your mind and with unwavering faith, you will receive the reward for your service. And there will be
blessing and remembrance for you throughout all generations. In the new world you will receive a good reward. Because of you there will be hope and life for Eve and her children.
For in your own person you removed the spear that had been a barrier around the tree of life. And in your own person there came to be peace and reconciliation for all the worlds,
from now and forever. Amen. For I, who have appeared in your house, have come to fulfill the will of the Father who sent me.
Everyone who listens to me and believes will live. As for your own service, you have now completed it perfectly, without fault, so that you may receive a good reward for it.
From now on I turn to all my brothers throughout the whole world, so that I may fully carry out for those who believe in me everything the Father commanded me,
so that they may bear the fruits of eternal life. And I myself will give them all the promises of my Father.
which are accomplished through my hands and are given and handed on to my faithful ones and to everyone who believes in me.” And when we came to the first lodging place,
the sign of light appeared before us again. We were very glad and rejoiced. We knelt and bowed down to him on the ground before him, and we praised the vision.
We spoke together with one voice and said to him, “We worship and give thanks for your kindness and your light, which accompanies our company everywhere.”
He answered and said to us, “I am everywhere, and there is no place where I am not. I am also where you left me, for I am greater than the sun.
There is no place in the world deprived of it, although it is only one. And if it is withdrawn from the world, all its inhabitants sit in darkness.
How much more, then, am I, who am the Lord of the sun! My light and my accompanying presence are greater than those of the sun.” We answered and said before him, “All these things,

our light and our life-giver, we know, and they are certain to us. We believe that all these wonders that we have seen, together with all your faithful ones, are small in comparison with your greatness.
For us, however, they are overwhelming, and our mouths cannot adequately describe them or give thanks for each one of them.”
When evening came, we brought out some of the provisions that had come with us from our land on our journey, so that we could enjoy them.
Then we were even more afraid, as we praised his greatness, which was with us and which he did not withhold from us in our weakness.
When we had eaten our evening meal of that food [?], each of us spoke words of joy and praise.
Like a spring gushing with abundant water, so we recounted visions and wonders, none of which were alike.
We praised him, our guide, our leader, and the light of our company, and his many forms and his glorious garments,
and his beautiful appearances and his perfect images among us. We traveled through all our lodging places with his glorious signs until we reached our borders.
All our families and our children, and many of the people of our land, came out to meet us.
When they heard that we had arrived, they met us with great joy and welcomed us, glad and rejoicing and offering praise. They marveled at our appearance and at the good health of our entire company.
When we came among them, they gathered and came to us. We began to tell them and recount to them how our journey had taken place,
and about the marvelous visions that accompanied us, our entrance into Jerusalem, and everything that was said to us,
and about our journey to Bethlehem, and the glorious visions and revelations of the Father of supreme majesty that appeared to us in the cave:
the great light and the marvelous visions in the bodily form of a humble human being.
And about the light of the star that went before us like a glorious guide, and how we entered again and saw indescribable glory before us,
and fell down and worshiped the divine child of the great light, while two angels stood there and the pillar of cloud stood there.
Just as we had previously seen all the visions on the Mountain of Victories, in the Cave of Treasures of Hidden Mysteries in our land, so in that cave they were all truly fulfilled.
Also about the appearances and garments of the glorious and divine child who appeared to us in the cave at Bethlehem.

He spoke to us and taught us: “Look, all the mysteries, wonders, symbolic forms, and revelations are being fulfilled, along with everything spoken about me by the prophets and throughout the whole world.”
From the first day until today. Now let the will of the one who sent me be fulfilled in me, and let me accomplish everything for which he sent me.
And we offered him the offerings that we had taken from the Cave of Treasures, which had been set aside for our fathers from his own possessions. And we worshiped him, the Lord of worship.
And he opened his majestic and glorious mouth and spoke gently with us. According to our ability and capacity to hear him, he sowed the word of life within us.
And he told us and revealed to us the land of life and the exalted kingdom of the Father of majesty, the Lord of all, who sent him to heal the worlds, to cure their sickness,
because they could not be healed through any of the former prophets, but only through the will of the Son who brings mercy to fulfillment.
And we set out to return to our country in peace. And as we came to the first stopping place, rejoicing and celebrating all along the way,
we again found our guide and our light, with all his forms that we had seen before us. And we trembled and were greatly afraid, while
we worshiped and praised his majesty, which accompanied our camp. Our provisions also filled our containers,
overflowing through his blessings and exceeding even the provisions we had brought with us, while our containers were full and overflowing with them,
because of the power of his blessings that rested upon us, so that we might explain to you, and you might believe, everything—the visions and wonders that we saw—
and so that you too might be worthy to become his faithful and chosen ones, and his great power and his revelations might dwell with you also.
For he is truly here also, with us, as he told us, and we believe that his light has not departed from our camp.
Moreover, he is also present throughout the whole world. For he is light, sufficient for everyone, and he gives light through his perfect love.
Take without doubt, with an undivided heart and true faith, all who wish, and eat some of these provisions that came with us.
And may you too be worthy to share in his blessing, which accompanies us and is with us forever. And some of them joyfully and lovingly took some of those provisions,
and ate. And they began to rejoice and celebrate, praising and telling one another everything that appeared to them.
One of them said, “At the very moment when I ate some of these provisions, I saw a great light that has no likeness in the world.”
And another said, “I saw God bringing himself to birth in the world as he willed.” And another said, “I saw a star of light whose light darkened the sun.”
And another said, “I saw a human being whose appearance was more disfigured than that of any man, giving life to the world and cleansing it through his blood and his humble appearance.”
And another said, “I saw something like a lamb hanging on the tree of life, and through him and his blood salvation came to all the creatures of the world.”
And another said, “I saw a pillar of light dwelling within the womb of the earth, and the dead were rising to meet him, worshiping and praising him with great joy.”
And those who had eaten some of those provisions told one another many other things, far more than these.
And their minds poured forth abundant praise day after day. And there was great joy throughout the whole land of the East.
And in the love of our Lord, nobles and poor people, women and children from the whole country gathered together,
coming to the nobles who were called Magi. And they would come and hear from them a new and glorious teaching.
And mysteries and revelations, and everything that was spoken with them from the first day when they set out from their country until they arrived in joy.
And day by day, further revelations and visions were added to them, and all their [?] were powerful.
And faith grew in love for the testimony of our Lord Jesus Christ, through the miracles that the child of light who had appeared to them performed through their hands.
Until he had fulfilled in everything the will of the one who sent him, and he ascended in glory to the height that had formerly been his dwelling. And the faith of those who heard increased.
And when Judas Thomas came down there again, by the will of our Lord who sent him, faith increased still more among those who heard.
Through the many miracles and signs that Judas Thomas, the apostle of our Lord, performed there. And when the leaders heard of the departure of
Judas for that place, as the light that had appeared to them had told them, they gathered and went to him to join him in prayer and faith.
And they greeted Judas with perfect love, rejoicing in our Lord. Judas, too, rejoiced greatly in them.
And they rejoiced in our Lord, and Judas, too, rejoiced greatly in them. And after they had been with him for some days, they told Judas
how, from the first day, they had been found worthy to receive this gift of the light of the world, and about their journey up to him at Bethlehem,
and everything that [?] with them, and about the [?] and visions they saw there in the cave, and about their journey down, how he accompanied them,
their entire camp, with his light, with many visions and revelations. And when Judas the apostle learned
that it was the gift of our Lord that had been poured out upon them, he too told them about our Life-giver, while all the brothers were gathered together.
And about the miracles, healings, and mighty deeds that he performed before the eyes of his own apostles, and about the likenesses of his appearances and his wondrous forms,
which we cannot fully describe, for he would appear to us at all times, so that we were amazed at him and stood in [?]
and uncertainty of mind, for never since the beginning of the world had he appeared to anyone in this way. And when all the brothers heard,
as Judas told them, they all praised with one voice the Lord of exalted majesty, through his Son, the will that brings life to perfection.
And they asked Judas, the apostle of our Lord, to join them with himself in the seal of our Lord. Judas said, “My brothers, I too rejoice,
because it was for this gift that I was sent by Life. For anyone who believes in Life and lovingly receives in truth the seal of my Lord Jesus
Christ cannot be ruled by the enemy.” Now, on the night before Sunday,
Judas took the brothers who had asked him, rejoicing that they too would receive the seal of our Lord, and went out to a spring of water.
And he took oil, offered praise over it, and said, “We praise you, mystery of life [?], for through oil anointing has been given to us by grace.
Praise to you, hidden mystery, given to us through oil for life, by grace, for anointing. Praise to you, hidden mystery, given to us through oil for life and forgiveness.
Through it he gives us light and drives darkness and error away from us. And through its mystery, the athletes in the contest overcome their enemies.
Praise to you, mystery of oil, for you have been found worthy to have fellowship with Christ. Through it the victors in the contest are crowned, and you are paired with the Spirit.”
And he too flew over the waters like his consort, the Holy Spirit, who joins the soul with the mind and renews the body through birth into life.
Come, partner of the Firstborn. Come, you who renew human beings through birth into eternal life, and rest upon these believers, the beloved of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Cleanse them and sanctify them from all the stains of their bodies, and let them become temples for you to dwell in,
and a resting place for the Son of perfect love. And may you sanctify them completely through birth into life. And he baptized them in the name of the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.
When they had all come up from the water, a boy of heavenly light appeared to them, descending from heaven, and said to them, “Peace be with you,
all you who share my mysteries. Look, through your birth just now, all the visions and revelations you have seen from the first day have been fulfilled.”
They were afraid and fell to the ground. When they stood up, he appeared to him in the form of a glorious, divine young man. He took a whole loaf of bread, offered praise, and broke it.
He gave it first to Judas the apostle, and then to each one of them, and said to them, “This is the completion and seal of your birth into life.
From now and forever, stand firm in my promises.” When he disappeared from their sight, they saw him again ascending to heaven in glory without end.
Judas said, “We praise your gracious majesty, your oneness with its many persons, and your glorious forms that you have shown us,
and the garments you put on for our sake, so that we might put on your mighty majesty. And by how many names you have been called,
though you are not contained in any one of them! For only you yourself know your great name and your majesty—you and your exalted Father,
and no one else. All these forms you put on and appeared in for our sake, so that we might know you, because you loved us with the great compassion you had for us.
Everything your crucifiers brought upon you, you endured for our sake, although you are exalted above all suffering and are of the same nature as the one who does not suffer,
so that salvation might be ours through your grace. For our sake you endured everything and bore everything. For you are our advocate, our guide, our light, and our giver of life.
Because we have believed in you, we have everything in you. You have given us everything completely, with the assurance of your love for us, for you endured everything for our sake.”
All the new disciples of the word of life responded and said with great joy, “We praise, worship, and give thanks

to your majesty, which human mouths cannot express, because we are too weak for it, and to your great light, which you have made shine upon our weakness. In your compassion you have made us worthy of fellowship with you in eternal life.”
While they were greatly delighting in thanksgiving, prayer, and visions of our Lord, many brothers were being added to the faith day by day.
Judas said to them, “My brothers, now let us fulfill the command of our Lord, who said to us, ‘Go out into the whole world and proclaim my good news.’
Now, my brothers, you too must become preachers of the word like us, because you too have received the gift of our Lord.
You too must go out everywhere and proclaim to everyone the gift of our light and our giver of life, who withholds nothing.” And they went out from there to every place.
With perfect love they proclaimed the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Lord of all. They too performed miracles and healings in the name of our Lord,
which human mouths cannot describe, through the Holy Spirit poured out upon them by the gift of our Lord.
They proclaimed the true faith, telling and teaching everyone, “Flee from darkness and come to the light that does not pass away.”
So that you may live and find shelter beneath the wings of our Lord Jesus, our life-giver and our great refuge on the last day,
from the terrible judgment of the fire that comes suddenly to cleanse the whole earth of the error that had ruled over it through its deceit.
And through faith you will escape the burning fire and enter the rest prepared for all the chosen and faithful who have believed in the offspring of the perfect light and in everlasting life,
in the kingdom of my Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Lord of all in his exalted majesty, in his new world and in his exalted, great light, which does not pass away
forever, and in his glorious rest. You will rest forever and ever. Amen and amen. The account of the Magi and their offerings is completed.
In the year 2019 of Abraham, Herod killed the infants of Bethlehem because of Christ.
In the year 2020, Herod himself killed the children of Bethlehem from two years old and under,
according to what the Magi had told him, thinking that Christ would be killed along with them. Then God's sentence overtook him, the sentence that he and his deeds deserved.
First he developed a slight fever whose burning did not show outwardly, while inwardly its torment grew worse.
He did not even want to take food, because his bowels were not moving. There was an ulcer and pain, and his [?] rotted and swarmed with worms.
Shortness of breath afflicted him, also distressing him with a foul and oppressive smell.
Severe pains struck him from every side, and he had no strength to endure them. God apportioned him among different pains.
Yet while he was tormented by all his pains, he still struggled to live and looked for medical treatment and the recovery of his body.
He also went to bathe in the hot springs at Callirrhoe, whose waters flow into Lake Asphaltitis. And while
he was there, the physicians wanted to bathe his body in oil. When he was immersed in a vessel full of oil, his whole body went limp and his eyes rolled back.
His servants became greatly alarmed. But he endured the pain, though he despaired of his life. From there he returned to Jericho.
He grew bitter and raged against death, for he became bold in plotting an evil deed. He gathered from all the towns of the Jews
all the prominent and important men to the place called the horse-racing arena and ordered them to be confined there.
He summoned his sister Salome and her husband Alexas and said to them, “I know that the day of my death will be a great festival for the Jews.
But mourning can be made for me through others, and there can be a house of weeping [?] for me, if you are willing to carry out my command.
When I die, set men upon these people who are imprisoned and kill them. Then, even against their will, they will weep for me.”
While he was being torn by the severe pain of coughing, he thought of killing himself. He took an apple and asked for a knife,
for he was accustomed to cut it up and eat it that way. Afterward he got up to see whether anyone was there to stop him, and raised his right hand to kill himself.
A short time before his death, in addition to those two sons of his whom he had killed, he also killed the third. And so he died in bitter pain,
already seeing here the torment that was reserved for him. These are the high priests known in the days of Christ: Annas, and after him Ishmael son of Phabi.
After him came Eleazar, the son of Annas, and after him Caiaphas, who is Josephus the historian. This was the high priest at the time of the Passion.
He also lived until Jerusalem was destroyed. After Herod, Archelaus became king over the Jews, for
nine years. At this time Judas the Galilean became known, the one mentioned in Acts. He led many people astray and brought them out into the wilderness.
When he sought to enter Jerusalem in the guise of that Messiah who was awaited according to the Scriptures, and approached the Mount of Olives with a large army,
the Roman army came out against him and killed him. His entire army was also scattered and perished.
In the year 2022, there was a great, severe, and devastating famine in Rome and throughout all the western lands,
until that land was deprived of wheat and barley. A modius of wheat, according to the standard measure, was being sold
for 1,027½. In the year 2024, a certain Abgar became king over Edessa.
In the year 2029, King Archelaus was banished to Bena, a city of Galatia. In his place came Herod the tetrarch, for
twenty-four years. In that same year Augustus died, having reigned for fifty-six years and six months.
After him Tiberius reigned for thirteen years. In the year 2034, there was a great and severe earthquake in the land of Asia.
